remarks:
Welcome to this exceptional East Amherst residence, where thoughtful updates, timeless design, and impeccable
craftsmanship come together to create a truly move-in-ready home. From the moment you arrive, you'll
appreciate the extensive exterior improvements, including a 6 week old roof, all-new windows and doors, and
professionally updated landscaping that enhances the home's impressive curb appeal. Step inside to discover a
dramatic two-story foyer and soaring 15-foot ceilings that create an incredible sense of space and light. The
stunning great room serves as the heart of the home, featuring a breathtaking floor-to-ceiling brick fireplace and
an open, inviting layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The formal dining room provides the
perfect setting for special gatherings, while the beautifully renovated custom kitchen is sure to impress with its
handcrafted cabinetry, quartz countertops, pantry cabinet, and spacious breakfast area. Enjoy peaceful mornings
and summer evenings overlooking the private backyard from the expansive two-tier deck, offering a serene
setting with no rear neighbors. The second floor features three generously sized bedrooms with abundant closet
space and a beautifully updated hall bathroom complete with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, a separate
soaking tub, and a tiled shower. The vaulted primary suite is a true retreat, boasting soaring ceilings, ample
closet space, and a luxurious ensuite bath featuring a custom tile shower, custom vanity, and quartz countertops.
Every detail of this home has been thoughtfully updated and meticulously maintained. Don't miss this rare
